description:
# Niconico YT Integration Test 1.49.0-niconico.1

Personal test build in david419kr's fork only. This is not an official Morphe release, and no upstream PR has been opened.

## Changes
- Integrate Niconico-style public live/replay chat into the upstream patch and extension modules.
- Reuse upstream video ID, playback time, playback speed, player-state events, and player-button hooks. No standalone fingerprints or resource mapper are added.
- Include the upstream patches in the same bundle. The Niconico patch is opt-in and initially supports YouTube 21.20.405 only.
- Use the distinct source name **Niconico YT Integration Test**.

Base: MorpheApp/morphe-patches dev at c5f9f94ee71a480be00a432ee364f4e7099b9537. Standalone feature source: david419kr/niconico-yt-morphe-patches 1.3.3.

## Validation
- 149 upstream/integration unit tests passed, including all 17 Niconico feature tests. Five upstream YouTube Music tests requiring a Music APK were skipped.
- Built the Android-compatible MPP and verified its name, version, source URL, and classes.dex.
- Applied the final personal test bundle to the unmodified YouTube 21.20.405 APK: all 107 selected patches succeeded and APK rebuilding completed.
- Actual phone installation and playback have not yet been verified. Other YouTube versions and legacy player controls remain untested for this feature.

## 폰에서 적용
1. Morphe에서 **Expert mode**를 켭니다.
2. **Sources → + → Remote**에 `https://github.com/david419kr/morphe-patches`를 추가합니다.
3. **Niconico YT Integration Test**, 버전 **1.49.0-niconico.1**을 확인합니다.
4. 테스트하는 동안 기존 **Morphe Patches**와 독립 **Niconico YT Comments Patches** 소스를 **Disable**하고 테스트 소스만 켭니다. 공식 패치가 이미 이 번들에 포함돼 있습니다.
5. 원본 **YouTube 21.20.405 APK**를 선택합니다.
6. 테스트 소스의 권장 패치를 유지하고 **Niconico-style live/replay comments (Experimental)**를 직접 선택합니다.
7. 패치 후 설치합니다. **弾** 버튼은 댓글 켜기/끄기, 길게 누르기는 크기·불투명도 설정입니다.

기존 standalone 1.3.3 원격 소스와 배포 파일은 변경하지 않았습니다.

For English instructions and the branch layout, see LOCAL_TEST_RELEASE.md in this fork.
